subject: [PATCH 24/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict the reclaim advice of MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations to common memory only. The changes involve converting ZONE_DEVICE checks in various functions to use folio_is_common_memory() instead.
